title: tmuxinator project config (strict)
description: Written for this repo; tmuxinator publishes no schema. Keys follow tmuxinator 3.4.2 (lib/tmuxinator/project.rb, window.rb, pane.rb, hooks/project.rb). Deliberately strict: deprecated keys (project_name, project_root, tabs, pre, post, pre_tab, cli_args, rbenv, rvm) are rejected and every object forbids unknown keys. The schema sees only parsed YAML, so it cannot stop ERB (tmuxinator renders the raw file, comments included, through ERB first); scripts/checks/no-erb rejects any '<%' in the raw file before tmuxinator runs.

root.description: The project root; windows start here unless they set their own root.

windows.description: Windows in order. Each item is a one-key map from the window name to its definition.

startup_window.description: The window selected after start, by name or index.

startup_pane.description: The pane selected in the startup window.

pre_window.description: Commands run in every pane before its own commands.

tmux_options.description: Extra options passed to every tmux invocation.

enable_pane_titles.description: Show pane titles in the pane border.

command.description: One shell command typed into a pane. ERB is not allowed, so the file stays plain YAML.

root.description: The window root, relative to the project root.

layout.description: A tmux layout name or a custom layout string.

synchronize.description: Synchronize panes (true or before: before the commands run; after: after them).

pre.description: Commands run in every pane of this window before its own.

focused_pane.description: The pane selected in this window, by index or title.

oneOf.description: A titled pane: a one-key map from the title to its commands.
